hypothesis: On each of the six already-observed development images, a smaller within-image prediction-rank gap identifies more frozen >=10%-GT-contrast ordinal errors; this is a non-geometric ambiguity baseline, not a calibrated confidence or novel reliability method.
selection_rationale: Two-scene ordinal signal passes but does not imply error discrimination. Use exactly one simple parameter-free prediction-only control before any geometric/learned score. Existing D1/D2/H1/Cauchy failures remain stopped.
pre_registration_limits: GT outcomes and error examples of all six images were already observed; candidate descriptor/risk values have not been computed. This is a frozen exploratory development screen, not a blind confirmation.

inherited_protocol.main_cells: same frozen cells with>=16 eligible pairs; no resampling/refill, new contrast or masks
inherited_protocol.pair_memberships: retain source-cell memberships and report canonical unique/repeated edges
inherited_protocol.target_loss: unchanged model q vs original evaluator Z: correct0,wrong1,exact q tie0.5,invalid either endpoint1
inherited_protocol.aggregation: same per-cell means, local/cross half each,three-image equal scene mean; scene gates separate,not pooled

descriptor.name: prediction-only empirical-CDF rank margin
descriptor.scorer_inputs: six sealed raw q arrays and their two prediction seals only; no RGB,cameras,GT masks,GT-indexed nodes,pairs,Z,per-image errors or previous results
descriptor.domain: all integer working-grid centers x=2..1005,y=2..669, inclusive,independent of GT support
descriptor.valid: finite nonnegative raw q; q=0 valid
descriptor.numeric: promote raw float32 q values to float64, sort valid domain values; do not normalize using GT-selected nodes or interpolate a CDF image
descriptor.CDF: F(v)=(count(domain q<v)+0.5*count(domain q==v))/N; searchsorted left/right in float64; queried v may lie between domain values
descriptor.output: per-image sorted domain q values plus valid/invalid domain counts,shape,source hashes and complete-six-descriptor seal; no pair scores,weights or oracle output
descriptor.seal: All six descriptors complete before evaluator semantically opens/deserializes any evaluator-only cache. Trusted inventory controller may hash opaque bytes for provenance; scorer process never receives evaluator mounts or bytes.
descriptor.on_empty_or_insufficient_domain: blocked_prediction_descriptor_support; preserve all counts,no fill or alternate mask

pair_score.query: evaluator uses original native indices and unchanged raw-q four-neighbor float64 bilinear sampling; after sampling apply sealed global F to q_a/q_b
pair_score.risk: S_ab=1-abs(F(q_a)-F(q_b)); larger is more ambiguous; fixed sign, no learned threshold
pair_score.invalid_prediction_or_descriptor: score1 worst risk; target loss remains1 for invalid prediction. Shared invalid-node worst ordering in all feasible score controls; report separately,never drop.
pair_score.zero_or_equal_q: valid; equal q implies S=1 and target0.5 on eligible unequal-GT pairs
pair_score.not_a_pixel_confidence: pair ambiguity does not assign responsibility to a pixel or produce a depth-L1 training weight

risk_metric.retention: independently in each already-included cell:keep c*n lowest-risk memberships; fractional ties ensure exact requested membership mass,no index-based selection
risk_metric.tie_rule: For cell n and m=c*n,let t be score at zero-based ceil(m)-1;weights1 for S<t,0 for S>t,and (m-count(S<t))/count(S==t) on every S==t. No epsilon, no arbitrary stable-sort tie winner.
risk_metric.aggregation: same cells/strata/images as baseline at every coverage,not a new support subset; R_image(c)=0.5*(mean_local_cells+mean_cross_cells); R_scene=mean(all3 images)
risk_metric.identity_at_full_coverage: every score/control R(1) exactly reproduces retained baseline cell/stratum/image/scene loss within1e-12
risk_metric.secondary: report each coverage; optional explicitly named discrete_four_coverage_mean=(R(.25)+R(.5)+R(.75)+R(1))/4,not continuous AURC or a new acceptance target

controls.constant: all valid nodes/pairs constant risk0.5 (invalid prediction endpoint risk1); with these fully valid frozen samples,all coverages equal original baseline by fractional ties

score_only_shuffles.permutation: one PCG64 permutation of valid sampled-node F values in original native-index order;reuse across every local/cross pair;invalid masks fixed
score_only_shuffles.target_unchanged: never shuffle raw q used for baseline L,GT,indices,cells,or pair eligibility; this differs from prior ordinal-signal shuffled-prediction controls
score_only_shuffles.report: all20 seed/cell/stratum/image/scene risks plus mean,min,max; do not choose seeds or compute IID significance

controls.risk_oracle: evaluator-only risk S=L using actual frozen model target loss,kept fixed. It lower-bounds retained risk; at coverage1 it equals baseline,not zero. Not the earlier q=1/Z model oracle;never exported to scorer/training.

evaluation_support.error_bearing_cell: at least one wrong L=1 pair membership in either included stratum;count union of original source-cell IDs
evaluation_support.unique_pair_counts_status: conservative existing lower bounds93..581 support planning only;exact wrong graph/source-cell count not newly computed this review
evaluation_support.stratum_without_errors: retain in image/scene macro risk; mark discrimination/relative ratio unknown_no_error when R_stratum(1)=0. No success claim for this stratum; never remove it.
evaluation_support.on_failure: blocked_error_support for overall six-image screen; preserve all other diagnostics,do not drop image,change contrast or add a scene
evaluation_support.graph_reporting: unique wrong edges,distinct error-incident nodes,max-node error incidence,per-cell error concentration; counts do not make dependent pairs independent
evaluation_support.folds: No fitting and no OOF claim; do not randomly split correlated pairs into train/test. Image summaries and two scene summaries are descriptive; unseen scene required for confirmation.
evaluation_support.when_checked: Only in evaluator after complete-six-descriptor seal; this support cannot be certified by the prior metadata-only input gate.

engineering: all identities/roles,source fidelity and isolated no-GT descriptor stage pass
synthetic constant/equal/zero/invalid,CDF between-values,half-pixel,fractional boundary ties,source-cell membership and oracle checks pass
changing labels,nodes/pairs or errors cannot change descriptor;score shuffles cannot change L;every R1 reproduces original baseline
all six descriptors sealed before evaluator assets;new output refuses overwrite or source/input overlap
acceptance.each_stratum_no_harm: R_stratum(.5)<=R_stratum(1)+1e-12 for each of12 strata;zero-error stratum stays0 but discrimination remains unknown
acceptance.threshold_meaning: Operational development investment screen chosen before any descriptor/risk computation,not published universal standards,significance or calibrated probabilities.
acceptance.on_negative: stop this fixed margin hypothesis,no sign reversal,threshold/coverage/domain/contrast changes,mixture scores or extra inference;retain negative/unknowns
acceptance.on_positive: only supports a simple ambiguity control on observed development scenes. Require separately reviewed,unopened scene with protocol frozen before results for confirmation; do not call geometric reliability or enter weighting/training.

resources.streaming: one raw map/descriptor and one scene/image/control at a time;reuse frozen nodes/pairs,no all-native-pixel pairs

synthetic_review_examples.meaning: paper arithmetic only;zero valid,ties ambiguity high

synthetic_review_examples.retained_risk: same baseline at every coverage;fractional ties,no fabricated discrimination

synthetic_review_examples.meaning: Large prediction-rank gap can be confidently reversed; the hypothesis is falsifiable,not implied by using q in both score and target. Paper example only.

release_order: current:proposal/static inventory consistency only,no scoring/descriptor/risk curve
next separate authorization:minimal CPU descriptor/evaluator entry and synthetic/isolation checks,then metadata-only input gate;no real descriptor/risk computation or GT cache deserialization

after checks and explicit release:one frozen CPU diagnostic;seal all6 descriptors first,then evaluator reads frozen caches,checks error support and computes risk only if support passes;no new model inference
if passed,review separate unseen-scene confirmation data/protocol and costs before downloads or execution
only independent confirmation and an aligned training target could justify reviewing any weighting experiment;none released
cumulative_contribution: Independent sensor-supported ordinal structure in two development scenes plus a falsifiable prediction-only ambiguity-control protocol. Old D1/D2/H1/Cauchy routes remain stopped; no new scoring result,novel geometry reliability,or training benefit.

pre_execution_input_gate.allowed: Validate explicit role lists,source/prediction seals,byte sizes/hashes and prediction header dtype/shape only;no CDF,score,GT cache deserialization or new target statistics.
pre_execution_input_gate.unknown: Exact unique wrong-pair/error-cell/error-node support deferred until post-descriptor-seal evaluator;blocked remains distinct from hypothesis failure.

leakage_caveat: Score and target both depend on the same frozen model q; GT-contrast>=10% conditions the sample. A positive association is an internal ambiguity baseline, not independent geometric evidence, calibrated risk or causal diagnosis.
